contracts.fact: Existing LC_CODE_SIGNATURE denotes terminal LINKEDIT bytes; old layout and overflow must be checked before allocation.
The allocator changes LINKEDIT filesize to its new extent and rounds LINKEDIT vmsize to 0x4000.
Allocate signature capacity, reopen the changed executable before building hashes, then ensure the finished SuperBlob fits the reservation.
Build CodeDirectories from the allocated executable, sign the primary raw CodeDirectory, populate all CodeDirectories and the CMS wrapper, then write the embedded signature.
Identifiers, team, executable segment, Info, requirements, CodeResources, XML/DER entitlements and constraints are CodeDirectory inputs/special slots.
Signer uses SHA256 detached CMS over the complete raw CodeDirectory and includes v2 hash-agility plus the v1 cdhashes property list.
Special hashes index backwards from hashOffset; absent allocated special slots contain zeroes.
Hash type 3 uses the actual truncated SHA256 hasher, yielding 20 bytes; do not replace its full hasher result with a 32-byte SHA256 value.
SecKeyCopyPublicKey supplies the public key. Only its public external representation is compared with the actual certificate public key; no private representation is requested.
SecKeyCreateSignature and SecKeyVerifySignature are public APIs available on iOS 10+, suitable for this iOS 17 target.
SecKeyIsAlgorithmSupported checks whether the concrete key supports the exact sign/verify algorithm.

implementedInterface.operation: nonisolated static async resign(Data, identity, originalAnchors, replacementAnchors, at, externalSpecialSlots, replacementExternalSpecialSlots) throws -> Result
implementedInterface.externalSlotContract: externalSpecialSlots authenticates OLD bytes only; replacementExternalSpecialSlots accepts only already-sealed slot 3. Slot 1 is immutable. Rebuilt hashes and output verification consume the merged NEW resources.
implementedInterface.outputProof: Actual Hashes.verify + Signed.bind facts for original and output; output authenticates actual certificate/key and raw CodeDirectory bytes, without Apple/profile/resource-tree/install permission.

supported: Existing terminal signature; thin64 little-endian arm64-all MH_EXECUTE; known bounded load commands; final aligned LINKEDIT; unchanged signed CD templates/identity/page geometry; SHA1/SHA256/truncatedSHA256/SHA384; RSA2048..8192 and EC256/384 with SHA256 CMS.
typedRemaining: nonterminal signatures and unsupported extra signature slots
simultaneous SHA256 and truncatedSHA256 V2 OID collision
adding CodeResources where it was not previously sealed
integrationRemaining: SDK/typecheck and actual Swift signer execution
consume the vault generation/revocation lease before signing and package publication
package-wide bottom-up nested signing, actual new CodeResources trees and modern profiles
